about: GPL components the licence check searches native binaries and WebAssembly modules for, in Python wheels (python_dists.py) and npm packages (licences.ts). Each has namespace markers, one of which must be present, and package markers that name a GPL package of that component, as they appear inside mangled C++ symbol names. The CGAL packages are those CGAL's Package Overview lists with 'License: GPL' (https://doc.cgal.org/latest/Manual/packages.html, read 2026-09-25); its kernel and support packages are LGPL and are not listed. Adding a marker tightens the check; removing one lets more through and is listed for review first.
